earlier_scan.note: Glottolog: retired entry, ISO sgo marked non-existent 2015 — spurious language

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid page song1304 'Songa' (Bookkeeping; retired, 'non-existent'; ISO CR 2014-028).
sources.note: Nothing; confirms retired/spurious status, zero descriptive references.

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority. 2014. Change Request Number 2014-028: retire [sgo] Songa (adopted, effective 2015-01-12). SIL International.
sources.note: Nothing; p.2 rationale: 'There is no evidence that the language exists' -- Songa/Kisonga listed as unclassified Bantu of South Kivu with no location or population; no sign of such a language (Kadima 1983, Moeller 1936) unless it is Kisanga, which falls under Lega-Shabunda [lea].

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority (submitter Douglas W. Boone, SIL Eastern Congo Group). 2012. Change Request Number 2012-154: retire [sgo] Songa as equivalent to Buyu [byi] (rejected 2013-01-23). SIL International.
sources.note: Nothing; p.2 rationale: 'Kisonga means the language of the Basonga, one of the peoples who speak the Buyu language' (Babuyu Collectivity, Kabambare Territory, Maniema).
